test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Choose the word that means the same as "Respect".
solution: **The correct answer is: Option 1) Deference.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Deference** means humble submission and respect. (आदर, विनयशीलता) • **Example:** He treated his elders with deference and respect. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Deference**.
